title: Reeding Assay
description: Immutable 15-minute forecast-to-outcome evidence record for the Reeding Edge engine (PRE). An Assay is FROZEN before settlement; settlement is APPENDED, never used to overwrite a frozen forecast field. Census is separate from Andrew's personal bet ledger.

assay_id.description: Immutable, deterministic identifier: SHA-256 hex of (engine_version + forecast_time + interval_ticker). Once assigned it MUST NOT change and MUST NOT collide between two distinct forecasts of the same interval by the same engine version.

engine_version.description: Version tag of the PRE engine that produced this forecast, e.g. 'pre-0.1'. Drives grade scoping — grades are version-specific, never pooled across versions.

forecast_time.description: ISO8601 timestamp (UTC, with timezone offset) marking when the forecast was FROZEN. MUST be strictly before occurrence_time and before any settlement.

interval_ticker.description: Kalshi market ticker identifying the 15-minute contract this Assay forecasts, e.g. 'KXBTC15M-26SEP022115'.

occurrence_time.description: ISO8601 timestamp (UTC) of the 15-minute slot this Assay forecasts. The slot being predicted — distinct from forecast_time (when the prediction was made).

verdict.description: Forecast direction. BUY_UP / BUY_DOWN are directional edges; SPECULATIVE is a directional lean below the action threshold; WAIT is no edge / hold.

confidence.description: Model confidence in its own verdict, 0..1 inclusive. Not a calibrated probability — see Grade.

rationale.description: Short, plain-language reason for the verdict. No hype, no guarantees.

market_context_snapshot.description: Frozen snapshot of market context at forecast_time. Immutable once the Assay is FROZEN.

target_price.description: Price threshold the 'up' outcome resolves against for this interval (USD).

last_price_at_forecast.description: Spot BTC-USD last price at forecast_time (USD).

cost_assumption_cents.description: Assumed contract cost in cents used for EV preview at forecast time. Not a fill — no execution.

status.description: Lifecycle state. FROZEN = forecast locked, awaiting outcome. SETTLED = outcome appended. VOID = administratively invalidated (no outcome attached).

settlement.description: APPEND-ONLY. Null until the interval resolves. Once attached it MUST NOT be mutated or removed — a re-grade reads a new record, it never edits this one.

outcome.description: Observed market direction for the interval.

settlement_price.description: Reference settlement price (USD) used to derive the outcome.

settled_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp (UTC) when the settlement was recorded. MUST be after forecast_time.

grade.description: Computed reliability assessment for this Assay's engine_version at the time of grading. UNGRADED / PROVISIONAL / CALIBRATED. Null until first computed; recomputed by appending a fresh grade record, never by editing.

created_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp (UTC) when the Assay record was first persisted (FROZEN).

schema_version.description: Version of the Assay schema this record conforms to.
